description: WHEN: you have a large technical tool output (get_object_details, validate_best_practices, ado_analyze_workitem, detect_performance_issues...) and need it reframed for a non-technical audience. Calls the local Ollama instance (OLLAMA_HOST env var, default localhost:11434) to produce the summary. Model is configurable via ALMXPP_SUMMARIZE_MODEL (default: llama3.2).

text.description: The technical text to summarize/explain -- typically the raw output of another tool call.

name: summarize_for_stakeholder
